messages:
Maya: Quick game — one-line office ghost stories only. I’ll start: 'There was a sticky note on my monitor that said "We’re watching your coffee." It was written in my own handwriting.' :ghost:
Jon: I keep getting calendar reminders for a meeting called "Remember the light" at 3:07 AM. The calendar is empty when I open it.
Priya: Yesterday the microwave beeped three times long after my lunch was gone. The leftover container I threw out two days ago was back on the shelf.
Carlos: Our desk plant was moved two seats over. It has my leftover lunch in its pot now.
build-bot: deploys/infra — all services green. Also: there is a phantom channel #plants that no one can join.
Lena: I put my headphones down and they were on the chair across the room when I came back. I was alone.
Anika: Whoever keeps changing the office playlist to whale sounds at 4 PM: please stop. Also it’s not whales.
Raj: Every morning my keyboard has one extra keycap turned upside down. I don’t remember doing it.
Maya: :laughing: love these. New rule — reactions count as votes for the spookiest one. May the eeriest win.
Jon: :ghost: (vote)
Priya: :eyes: (vote)
Carlos: :raised_hands: (vote)
Lena: Also, follow-up: coffee machine dispenses an extra drop after you walk away. It’s like it’s sighing.
Anika: I voted for Maya’s sticky note thing. It feels like the printer wrote it for me.
Raj: Alright team, final tally by noon. Whoever loses buys the winner a mysterious, slightly warm cookie.
Maya: Deal. If the cookie’s warm when I get it, I’ll assume this was all a very caffeinated haunting. :cookie:
